notes:
Video Studio now uses shorter render batches for Storybook cartoon on graphics cards with up to 16 GiB of memory. The same four-second shot on an RTX 3060 12 GB took 4 minutes 1 second in regular Cartoon and 2 minutes in Storybook cartoon. Both used the same seed, artwork, 1280 × 704 canvas and all 16 sampling steps. Storybook draws eight distinct frames per second and delivers a 24 fps MP4.

During a longer production, a single eight-second batch took over ten minutes and used 6.77 GiB of shared GPU memory on that PC. The new renderer measures card capacity at launch, splits new work on smaller cards and reuses already-verified longer shots when resuming. Tests cover continuity, shorter batches, recovery of larger completed shots and the final frame count. Workbench also preserves compatible H.264 picture packets when attaching a matched soundtrack. Source commit b4684c48788f908dfb7907eb4f143b277435d3c0.
